entities.name: Paging identity
entities.description: Information element that indicates the identity used for paging for non-EPS services. It is a type 3 information element with 2 octets length.

entities.name: Paging identity IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier field with fixed value 0000.

entities.name: Paging identity value
entities.description: Bit field that indicates the identity type used for paging: 0 for IMSI, 1 for TMSI.

entities.name: IMSI
entities.description: International Mobile Subscriber Identity used for paging when Paging identity value bit is 0.

entities.name: TMSI
entities.description: Temporary Mobile Subscriber Identity used for paging when Paging identity value bit is 1.

relations.description: The Paging identity IE contains the IEI field as part of its structure.
The Paging identity IE contains the identity value field as part of its structure.
When the Paging identity value bit is 0, IMSI is used as the paging identity.
When the Paging identity value bit is 1, TMSI is used as the paging identity.
